description: Industrialization and Political Democracy dataset distributed with the lavaan R package.
upstream_source_note: Documented by lavaan as originally retrieved from http://web.missouri.edu/~kolenikovs/Stat9370/democindus.txt (link no longer valid); lavaan also notes that the data are part of the larger public ICPSR 2532 dataset.
original_references: Bollen, K. A. (1989). Structural Equations with Latent Variables. Wiley Series in Probability and Mathematical Statistics. New York: Wiley.
Bollen, K. A. (1979). Political democracy and the timing of development. American Sociological Review, 44, 572-587.
Bollen, K. A. (1980). Issues in the comparative measurement of political democracy. American Sociological Review, 45, 370-390.

reference_statistics.reference_source_note: Reference values summarized from the lavaan SEM tutorial / PoliticalDemocracy example.

comparison_policy.identification_alignment: Use fixed marker loadings (1*x1, 1*y1, 1*y5) in the benchmark syntax to better align with the lavaan tutorial identification.
current_assertion_scope: Expanded Level C selected loading / regression / residual-variance checks
Expanded Level C selected residual-covariance checks
notes: CSV and provenance metadata are already stored in-repo.
The benchmark now uses fixed-marker syntax so that selected measurement and structural parameters can be compared more directly against the lavaan tutorial output.
Observed residual covariance is now connected through the measurement Theta path and is covered by selected automated benchmark assertions.
The current prototype still keeps relatively宽松 tolerances for selected residual covariances, because full lavaan-level equality across all parameters is not yet the target at this stage.
Automated assertions now cover loadings, structural regressions, selected residual variances, selected residual covariances, and fit-profile sanity checks.

usage_in_repository: SEM benchmark regression tests and reference comparisons.

copyright_and_reuse.public_domain_note: Current upstream documentation does not establish that this dataset is in the public domain.
copyright_and_reuse.repo_distribution_note: This repository stores a CSV copy for benchmark use together with provenance and citation metadata.
